sys_atf_test.name: Day-2 SAM: test_mode canned responses vs. live-mode fail-closed behavior
sys_atf_test.description: getRequestStatus/fetchIdentityRequest return canned success under test_mode and fail-closed/inconclusive results under live mode with no SAM reachable — proving the dual-mode contract SamCorrelationClient's header documents actually holds.

sys_atf_step.description: Precondition: this suite runs with test_mode already true on a declared non-prod instance. Under it, both getRequestStatus and fetchIdentityRequest return canned "approved" data with no live call.

Flip test_mode off for this step only (saved/restored). With no live SAM base URL reachable, getRequestStatus must report inconclusive rather than approved, and fetchIdentityRequest must refuse — a failed or absent read is never treated as authorization.
After the restore in step 200's finally block, test_mode is back on — confirm the canned path returns, proving the flip is fully reversible and no state leaked between steps.
